# dual_screen_hinge

iPhone Duo-first Flutter plugin for continuous foldable hinge angles, posture,
reserved-region geometry, active screen role, and Android display modes.

Canonical API:
- DualScreenHinge.instance.events
- DualScreenHinge.instance.hingeAngleEvents
- currentState(), capabilities()
- startRearDisplay(), stopRearDisplay()
- startDualScreen(entrypoint, arguments), stopDualScreen()

Use responsive MediaQuery sizing and safe areas for general layout. Use this
plugin for raw angles, iOS division and camera reserved regions, richer
metadata, and display sessions. Active iOS division regions are also exposed
as cross-platform display features. Unknown native enum values map to unknown.
Screen identity remains nullable when it cannot be proven. No model allowlists
or private APIs.

Source: https://github.com/Code-Growers/dual_screen_hinge
Docs: https://code-growers.github.io/dual_screen_hinge/
